Name: WEATHER_ASSET_REPLACE_PARAM_ST
Description: Weather-dependent assets in sky maps. When a map with rows here loads, each of its assets whose model is listed in a row is shown only while the current weather (and asset limit ID) matches one of the rows listing it; other assets are unaffected.

Fields.Name: Map ID
Fields.Description: The sky map as 8 digits AABBCCDD (e.g. 10000099 for m10_00_00_99). Only rows with DD 99 are loaded (98 instead in an alternate game state); open-world rows need BB and CC 00 (60000099, 61000099).

Fields.Name: Weather
Fields.Description: The weather (WeatherParam row ID) in which this row's assets are shown.

Fields.Name: State Value
Fields.Description: Value passed on to the world when this row matches the current Map State Key and Transition Source Weather; values above 9999 are ignored. What it controls is not established. Retail: 15-115 on the weather-0 rows of states 10-190, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Map State Key
Fields.Description: The row applies only while the current map state value equals this. Not a fire-ash flag. Retail: 10-190 on the m60 field rows (row 60NN00000+ has NN x 10), 998 and 999 on the 60998/60999 rows, 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Use Asset ID [4]-[7]
Fields.Description: Set: Asset ID [4]-[7] are used as well as [0]-[3]; clear: they are ignored. Retail: set on 2 rows (601400000, 601500000).

Fields.Name: Asset ID [0]
Fields.Description: Asset model shown in this weather (AEG999_999 -> 999999), matched against the map's asset parts. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Asset ID [1]
Fields.Description: Asset model shown in this weather (AEG999_999 -> 999999). -1: none.

Fields.Description: ID for production restriction. -1: Unlimited. Generation is allowed only if it matches the generation limit ID in Map default parameter .xlsm (SEQ08921).
